full_page.content:
Page 242 Oct. 29 Geo. Heckendorn - 37 - strep infection - very weak - Drs. ... Mrs. Lucy Lentzy - 57 - tuomer operation feared.
31 Yolanda Murphy - 33 - lost her baby 12 years ago -now fears repeat - asks for prayers.
Mrs. Mary F. Carroll - 58 - wants a home - can pay 4 % week - help a little if necessary ..
Miss F. Failles Tuxedo 2 - 0656 call after 4 p.m. - 1032 Kensington Rd .
1940, November
Nov. 2 Arthur J. Bungard - 16 - hopeless case of lukemia - 22 - to 3 days to live at transfusion yesterday. expects to have 3rd (trans.) to- morrow. Enrolled in Ser. Masses am sending them to C. ... for City of god.
H. Cameron - mail-carrier - Robbed ... would like to have the guilty plea guilty.
Page 243
Nov. 4 Richard Koss - 9 - bone trouble - broke leg when 9 months old trouble ever since. .
Elizab. Campeau - 70 - Stroke some - has quite a little pain ... Paul D. and Nancy O'Keefe - 3'2 and 2 slight infantile paralysis - threatening ....
5 Baby Ronald C. Adams - 6 mo. - seemingly born blind - Drs. om Ann Arbor propose to take Eye out to analyse it -
Mother Methodist - father -"Christian" - baptized method. and Catholic. Patricia Nesbauer - 14 - wayward. Mother dead. Father in Army. Liv- ing with her grandmother.
Mrs. Hanna George - 54 - Cancer of Stomach. Almost dead two years ago with same thing and completely recovered. Now has others ....
Donald and Gladys MacInnis - praying 17 yrs for family; seem to be unheard. Enrolled To-night 1.00 promising Perpetual Enrollment.
